CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexo_private.image_object_allowed(p_bucket text, p_name text, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when not (select nexo_private.is_admin()) then false else exists (
    select 1 from public.property_images i
    where i.storage_kind = 'managed'
      and i.storage_prefix = substring(p_name from '^properties/[^/]+/[^/]+/')
      and (
        (p_bucket = 'nexo-property-originals' and p_name = i.original_object_key and (
          p_action = 'read'
          or (p_action = 'insert' and i.processing_status = 'pending' and i.cleanup_requested_at is null)
          or (p_action = 'delete' and i.cleanup_requested_at is not null)
        ))
        or (p_bucket = 'nexo-property-images' and p_action in ('read','delete')
          and (p_action <> 'delete' or i.cleanup_requested_at is not null)
          and p_name ~ ('^' || i.storage_prefix || '[a-z0-9_-]+\.(jpg|webp)$')
          and (p_name = i.jpeg_path or exists (
            select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(i.webp_variants || i.jpeg_variants) v
            where v ->> 'src' = p_name
          ))
        )
      )
  ) end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexo_private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.admin_memberships
    where user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role = 'admin' and enabled);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexo_private.keep_original_hash()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.original_sha256 is distinct from old.original_sha256 then
    raise exception 'Original checksum is immutable' using errcode='23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexo_private.require_image_admin(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform 1 from public.admin_memberships
    where user_id=p_actor and role='admin' and enabled for share;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Administrative membership required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nexo_service_fail_image(p_actor uuid, p_property uuid, p_image uuid, p_token uuid, p_code text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform nexo_private.require_image_admin(p_actor);

  if p_code is null or p_code !~ '^[A-Z_]{1,80}$' then
    raise exception 'Invalid error code' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  update nexo_private.image_processing_attempts
  set status='failed'
  where token=p_token and image_id=p_image and status<>'ready';

  update public.property_images
  set processing_status='failed',
      processing_started_at=null,
      processing_error=p_code
  where id=p_image and property_id=p_property
    and processing_token=p_token
    and processing_status='pending'
    and storage_kind='managed'
    and cleanup_requested_at is null;
end $function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
